CITY OF ALHAMBRA
  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD | ACTION MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING – 7:00 P.M.
  City Hall Conference Room A
  111 South First Street

December 10, 2024

A. CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:00 P.M. in the Conference Room A of Alhambra City
  Hall.

B. ROLL CALL:
Present:
ANKIT UDANI, CHAIRMAN
NORA HERNANDEZ, VICE CHAIRMAN
MICHAEL DANINGER, MEMBER
STANLEY TSAI, MEMBER
JENNIFER NG, MEMBER
STEVE KUCHENSKI, SECRETARY

C. CONSENT CALENDAR:

ITEM 1:  MINUTES: November 26, 2024

  •  Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve as submitted
  the minutes of the November 26, 2024 meeting of the Design Review Board.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve all consent items.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

D. DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2:  1200 South Sierra Vista Avenue, DRB-2023-00208

  •  Request: This is an application for repairs to an existing retaining wall, add a new
  retaining wall, add a new vinyl fence on top of an existing low retaining wall, new
  paving and landscaping materials in the front and street side yard of an existing
  single-family residence.
  •  Applicant: Steven Chen

  1
   •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Reduce the height of the proposed front yard vinyl gate to line up with the
  overall height of the proposed front yard fence, which is about 3’-10”.
  2. Provide a note on the plans that states the proposed ‘Boxwood Shrub Plant’
  shall maintain a maximum of 3 ft. in height measured from finished grade.
  3. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Reduce the height of the proposed front yard vinyl gate to line up with the
  overall height of the proposed front yard fence, which is about 3’-10”.
  2. Provide a note on the plans that states the proposed ‘Boxwood Shrub Plant’
  will be maintained a maximum of 3 ft. in height measured from finished grade.
  3. Provide a matte finish on the proposed fence and a off-white or cream color
  selection that matches with the existing house color palette.
  4. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 3:  929 South Eighth Street, DRB-2024-00092

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 16 in. high front yard wall with a 3 ft. high
  single-leaf gate and a new 6 ft. high block wall along the south side of the property
  on an existing single-family property.
  •  Applicant: Kevin Guo
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL WITH CONDITIONS - The proposed project
  is approved with the following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Revise all notes for the proposed gate material to be ‘wood’. The wood gate
  and posts should be painted to match the existing house’s color palette.
  2. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to approve the application with the
  following Conditions of Approval:
  1. Update the elevations to graphically show the proposed 2” wall cap and not to
  exceed the overall height as presented.
  2. Revise all notes for the proposed gate material to be consistent throughout the
  drawings.

  2
   3. Revise the drawings to show a natural wood stain finish to be used for the
  proposed gate.
  4. Revise the proposed stucco color to be a neutral colors selection, such as a
  tan or cream color.
  5. The applicant shall resubmit a revised set of drawings for the City Architect to
  verify and approve.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

ITEM 4:  2576 Loma Vista Drive, DRB-2024-00083

  •  Request: This is an application for a new 2,176 SF 2-story single-family dwelling
  with an attached 2-car garage and front porch located at the front of an existing
  single-family property.
  •  Applicant: Jeffrey Liu, Jason Zhou (contractor was present)
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVAL - The proposed project is approved without
  conditions.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Hernandez makes a motion to continue the application with the
  following recommendations:
  1. The applicant should select an architectural style that is compatible with the
  existing neighborhood and further define the architectural characteristics of
  that style.
  2. The applicant should reference the predominant architectural styles listed in
  Alhambra Residential Design Guidelines in conjunction with the neighborhood
  characteristics.
  •  The second was by Board member Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio recordings of the
  discussion is available here: Audio

  3
 ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:10 P.M. to the next
  DRB meeting on January 14, 2025.

MOTION:

  •  Board member Daninger moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:10 P.M.
  •  The second was by Hernandez.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary
